【Free trial version】 Announcement of limited-number early distribution

The 【MT5 LBC7】 lets you do the PC version of MT5 & TradingView functions entirely in a smartphone app

📱 What you can do with LBC7 (on your phone)
✅Order placement with lot calculation
✅Market and limit entries via the built-in EA
✅Changing the built-in EA's parameters
✅App lock based on a 1-day loss limit
✅Batch closing of orders at a specified time
✅Batch setting of TP and SL by dragging
✅Display of the average entry price on the chart
✅Batch closing of positions from the chart
✅Push notifications to your phone
✅Display of custom indicators bundled with LBC7
✅Display of Exness's leverage restrictions
✅Switching to another account
✅Updating to the latest version from your phone

*The built-in EA uses averaging-down logic, and the number of splits, split width, breakeven management, adverse position management, and risk settings can be changed from the phone's home screen, and up to 3 logics can be registered at the same time 💡
This makes it possible to place and manage averaging-down logic that matches market conditions instantly from your phone ✨

*If the 1-day loss limit is exceeded, the app's ordering function is locked and orders placed from external MT5 are also force-closed. Money management settings can also be locked. (The lock is released by a request to the operators.)

Since some areas, such as differences in environment between brokers, are unverified, there may be minor bugs, but updating to the latest version can be done with 1 tap from the home screen, so once you download the LBC7 app 1 time, it will update to the latest version automatically without you doing anything 🧑‍💻

📩If you want to try the early version, please send a DM saying "LBC7 wanted".

【Attention】Can domestic bank transfers still be used after December 2026?

We directly asked 7 major overseas FX brokers whether deposits and withdrawals by domestic bank transfer will remain possible after December.

📌BigBoss
Undecided at this point about use after December

📌Exness
Available after December, and no plan to suspend at this point

📌FXGT
Details not finalized at this point, so can't advise

📌ThreeTrader
Collecting information and under consideration; can't convey any finalized information

📌Titan FX
No plan to suspend at this point, but will respond according to the situation

📌XS
No plan to suspend at this point, but recommends methods such as cryptocurrency

📌VantageTrading
Still available, but recommends transfers via stablecoins

At present, many brokers seem to be considering their future response. We plan to summarize the details in an article soon.

It would be nice to have a route that's easy to use 💦
